$comment: Per-surface ceiling on axe color-contrast INCOMPLETE nodes, keyed `<theme> / <surface.name>` (#1721, option 3). Never padded beyond an observed number, and a key with no row fails closed. Seeded 2026-09-06 from `npx playwright test accessibility.spec.ts` on the reserved harness ports, then RE-MEASURED on a second full run: all 48 keys reproduced exactly, none moved. Both runs used the browser recorded in `$browser` — which is the build `@playwright/test` resolves for the version pinned in package-lock, i.e. the same one CI's `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` fetches (ci.yml), so the browser is NOT an unreconciled variable between here and CI. (An earlier note here claimed this container aliases an older build in place of the expected one; `chromium.executablePath()` resolves the expected build, and both builds present are the same Chromium version, so that claim was wrong.) What is still unreconciled is everything else about a runner — installed fonts above all. If a CI run reds a key, the failure text names the seeded and the running browser: rule the environment out FIRST, and only then raise that key to max(local, CI) using the `axe color-contrast incomplete — …` log lines, noting here which keys disagreed and by how much. When a deliberate UI change raises a key, re-run that surface and commit the newly observed number with a one-line reason here; never lower another key in the same edit.
